title: Monotonicity of the tilt-excess under inclusion of balls
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^{n+l}, and V a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U such that x |-> V.tangentProj x is V.weight-a.e. strongly measurable. If 0 < s <= t, B̄_s(z) ⊆ B̄_t(w) ⊆ U (closed balls) and S is any linear subspace of R^{n+l}, then E(z, s, S) <= (t/s)^n E(w, t, S), where E = V.tiltExcess.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ (z w : Amb n ℓ) (s t : ℝ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), 0 < s → s ≤ t → closedBall z s ⊆ closedBall w t → closedBall w t ⊆ U → V.tiltExcess z s S ≤ (t / s) ^ n * V.tiltExcess w t S
